title: Selecting with loc and iloc, and the SettingWithCopyWarning

videos.script: Square brackets on a DataFrame do three different things. A name picks a column. A mask picks rows. A slice picks rows by position, or by label, depending on the index. {{brackets}} This lesson replaces the guessing with two accessors. Loc, for labels. Iloc, for positions. {{two}} Then it changes some values, in one step, on the table you mean to change. {{set}} And it meets the warning almost every pandas user has seen. Setting with copy. {{warning}} pandas 3 retired it. Every selection now behaves as a copy, and writing to it never touches the original. {{cow}} Run the same old script under pandas 2 and pandas 3. One line changes eleven thousand bikes in the old version, and none in the new one. {{bikes}} If you read code written before 2025, that difference is in it. {{end}}
